title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to disable/hide Power Automate action group for all users
summary: Disable the Power Automate action group for all Business Central users by marking 'Disagree for Everyone' on the Privacy Notices Status page, rather than managing permissions individually.
key_points: Power Automate Automate action group was introduced in BC20 (2022 wave 1) on all pages with data table context
Users cannot hide or move the Automate menu using personalization, though flows can be moved
The feature can be hidden per user via permission 9630 Allow Action Automate
Disabling for all users is simpler: use Privacy Notices Status page and select Disagree for Everyone on Microsoft Power Automate row
Sign out and back in after making the change for it to take effect

quotes.text: You can't hide or move the Automate menu or the Power Automate submenu and its actions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains a key limitation of personalization for Power Automate, making permission-based or tenant-wide controls necessary
